note: A single shaded pull-through grass site for up to ten people on First Fork Road (shown as Dry Run on Google Maps). The agency's route from Renovo follows PA 144 south 8.9 miles, turns sharp right onto Barneys Ridge Road, keeps right after 1.5 miles onto First Fork Road, and reaches the site in about a mile. The agency cautions that it is reached by remote dirt or gravel forest roads that may not suit low-clearance vehicles or large RVs. Stone fire ring; no table, toilet or water. Pack out trash. --Claude
summary: Site page re-read: SS019 still listed, Drive-In, Tent/Trailer categories, max vehicle 30 ft (equipment length 20), pull-through grass driveway 50 ft; count 1, 30 ft and pull_through confirmed, a sites note added. Year-round confirmed; sells in all five windows. Fees confirmed, $6.50 reservation fee added; hookups and facilities none. Imagery (Esri and PASDA leaf-off): pin on the forest road beside a small cleared pull-off loop just north-west; pin not moved. NHD: nothing within 200 m; not waterfront.
flags: Figures: 'Max Vehicle Length: 30' beside 'Equipment Length: 20' on a 35 x 20 ft site with a 50-ft pull-through driveway and a 50-ft spur. Max Vehicle Length is 23 ft or more but Equipment Length is under 23 ft: kept at 30 ft with all figures in the sites note, as the brief directs.

Agency access statements (ruling 11: nothing measured, no road surface, gate or bridge research): 'Caution: This campsite is accessed by remote state forest dirt or gravel roads and may not be suitable for some low-clearance vehicles or large RVs.' No grade lines on this page, no Severe grade, no 4WD, wet-weather or low-clearance statement (clearance 40 ft). Kept. Boilerplate on every page of the district, not site-specific: 'State forest roads are not maintained in the winter and often become snow covered, icy and potentially impassable' and '4WD vehicles may be recommended for some sites year-round, check notes' (this site's notes say nothing about 4WD).
ATV check (ruling 1): nothing on the site page, GIS record or district map places this site in an ATV parking lot. Kept.

Sproul advisories page (read 2026-11-10): nothing on this site's road. It carries a Bloody Skillet ATV section closure (April 20, 2026), the indefinite Left Branch Young Womans Creek Road closure, 'Stay Alert for ATVs on Roads' and a dust advisory.

NAME: the '(Snow Shoe)' in the stored name is only the booking system's loop label. The site is on First Fork Road off Barneys Ridge Road, about 10 road miles south of Renovo; the page notes Google Maps calls the road Dry Run. Suggest a name that says where it is; apply.py does not write names.
